description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken High Commander], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode (Lightning, Dark)], [Bitter Vengeance Mode] and [Grievous Slash] to the user

description.name: Awoken High Commander
description.text: Lightning and Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning and Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Lightning, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning]/[Attach Dark] after using a Lightning/Dark ability

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Bitter Vengeance Mode
description.text: Casts Grudge after using a Lightning or Dark ability, removed after triggering two times

description.name: Grievous Slash
description.text: Grants [Conditional Attach Element] (based on the Attach Element of the user) to allies in party slots 1 and 5 after using a Lightning or Dark ability, removed if the character hasn't Awoken High Commander, removed after using a Lightning or Dark ability

description.name: Conditional Attach Element
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Earth]/[Attach Wind]/[Attach Water]/[Attach Holy]/[Attach Dark]/[Attach Poison]

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Poison
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Poison damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Poison resistance +20%
